about.title: About
about.credits: Translation logic adapted from translate-shell; see the third-party notices.
about.automatic_hint: Once a day Verso asks GitHub for the latest version. The request carries no text and no identifier.
about.check_failed: Could not reach the update service. Try again later.
about.ready: Installed. Reopen Verso if it does not come back by itself.
about.failed: The update could not be verified. Nothing was changed.
about.diagnostics_copied: Diagnostics copied. Check them before pasting.
onboarding.title: Welcome to Verso
onboarding.subtitle: Translate selected or typed text instantly, without leaving the app you are in.
onboarding.engines_title: Which services may receive your text?
onboarding.engines_body: Verso translates through keyless online services. Both are on by default; turn off any you do not want to use. At least one must stay on.
onboarding.engine_google_receives: Google Translate receives the text you translate. No account is needed.
onboarding.engine_bing_receives: Microsoft Translator receives the text you translate. No account is needed.
onboarding.permission_body: macOS asks for the Accessibility permission before an app can read selected text in other apps.
onboarding.permission_windows: Windows needs no permission for selection capture.
onboarding.at_least_one: Keep at least one service on.
onboarding.shortcut_hint: Press {shortcut} in any app to translate a selection.
onboarding.updates_body: Once a day, Verso asks GitHub for the latest version. The request carries no text and no identifier.
